extracted.intended_audience: photojournalists, journalists, NPPA members, and general public interested in the National Press Photographers Association
extracted.subtask_description: Wikipedia article describing the National Press Photographers Association (NPPA), its mission, membership, activities, incorporation objectives, and mention of its Code of Ethics. The page summarizes organizational standards and goals that guide NPPA and its members.

rubrics_metrics.name: NPPA Code of Ethics
rubrics_metrics.description: Members of NPPA abide by a strict code of ethics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mentioned as a binding standard for members (citation: 'NPPA Code of Ethics'). The page does not reproduce the code text but references it as the ethical standard NPPA members follow; see NPPA site for full guidance (retrieved July 4, 2015).

rubrics_metrics.name: To advance press photography in all its branches
rubrics_metrics.description: To advance press photography in all its branches
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One of six key objectives listed in NPPA's original certificate of incorporation (incorporated October 3, 1947). These objectives function as organizational goals guiding NPPA activities (competitions, seminars, advocacy). The Wikipedia entry notes a citation is needed for the original certificate text.

rubrics_metrics.name: To promote the general welfare and conditions in the press photography field
rubrics_metrics.description: To promote the general welfare and conditions in the press photography field
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as an incorporation objective; frames NPPA's role in improving professional conditions for practitioners through programs like contests, workshops, and member services.

rubrics_metrics.name: To create, promote, and maintain cordial relations and cooperation, a higher spirit of fraternalism, the interchange of thought and opinion freely, and a high standard of conduct among its members
rubrics_metrics.description: To create, promote, and maintain cordial relations and cooperation, a higher spirit of fraternalism, the interchange of thought and opinion freely, and a high standard of conduct among its members
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporation objective emphasizing professional conduct, networking, mentorship, and open exchange of ideas; underpins NPPA programs such as the mentor program and discussion boards.

rubrics_metrics.name: To distribute and disseminate accurate information in regard to matters pertaining to the photographic press of the nation
rubrics_metrics.description: To distribute and disseminate accurate information in regard to matters pertaining to the photographic press of the nation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporation objective supporting NPPA's informational and advocacy activities (e.g., public statements, amicus briefs, resources for members).

rubrics_metrics.name: To settle equitably and justify the differences between its members
rubrics_metrics.description: To settle equitably and justify the differences between its members
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporation objective that frames NPPA's role in dispute resolution and maintaining internal harmony among members.

rubrics_metrics.name: To preserve, stabilize, unify, and coordinate all elements of the photographic press of the nation
rubrics_metrics.description: To preserve, stabilize, unify, and coordinate all elements of the photographic press of the nation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporation objective reflecting an organizational aim to act as a coordinating body for the photographic press; informs NPPA's national-level activities and standards.
